author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before the giving hand was a plain slab that read as a knife, and the receiving hand was an S squiggle glued to the heart. Now the giving hand is built like Lucide hand-heart (palm, thumb, fingers) with the heart on its thumb, and a separate receiving hand reaches down-left from the upper right at 45 degrees.
omissions: receiving hand's separate finger lines (reduced to one 45-degree reaching hand)
